Glance TV is an AI-powered shopping platform live on connected TVs, spanning ambient content, a dedicated shop app, and an AI shopping agent. We're looking for a UX Design Intern to work alongside our designers across the full surface area of the product. 
 What you'll do 
Contribute to UX and visual design across shopping cards, brand stores, editorial layouts, ambient surfaces, and agent interactions on the TV canvas 
Work through flows, states, and edge cases for live and upcoming features 
Help shape and maintain our design system — components, patterns, documentation 
Participate in critiques, explorations, and reviews alongside lead, visual, and motion designers 
Support handoff and partner with engineering through to ship 
 What we're looking for 
A design student or recent graduate with a strong portfolio that shows thinking and craft — how you frame problems, not just how things look 
Curiosity about interaction, behaviour, and how people actually use products 
Systems thinking — you notice patterns, care about consistency, and like building reusable things 
A maker's disposition — you like shipping, iterating, and getting your hands dirty 
Interest in AI, ambient computing, or the TV/large-screen medium is a plus
